# A.stand

> Zero-mutation multi-AI persistent subagent broker for Antigravity. Keeps the Antigravity Lead Agent focused on architecture, planning, and final verification while delegating heavy multi-file implementation (`Hephaestus`) and parallel read-only research/review (`Oracle`) to native external AI harnesses, with a side-panel console and real upstream Prompt Cache telemetry.

A.stand is an MCP plugin (5 concise MCP tools + orchestration skill + rules) that brokers persistent subagents across **OpenAI Codex CLI**, **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh` / ACP)** for DeepSeek, Gemini 4 and any OpenAI-compatible API or proxy, **Anthropic Claude Code CLI**, and the **Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**. Subagent context never floods the Lead chat: the Lead Agent receives a concise final report (typically 1–3K chars; replies above 24K chars are truncated with the full copy saved on disk).

- License: Apache License 2.0
- Runtime: Node.js >= 20 (Node.js >= 24.9.0 if using DeepSeek Harness `dsh`)
- Repository: https://github.com/jia-cyber957/A.stand
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/jia-cyber957/A.stand.git A.stand && cd A.stand && npm install && npm run install:antigravity`, then restart Antigravity once.

## Key capabilities

- **Real Lead-quota savings**: subagent context (often 200K+ tokens) stays isolated inside the subagent process; only a concise final report (full copy saved to `outputs/<jobId>.txt`) returns to the Lead.
- **Real upstream Prompt Cache**: 95%–99.8% hit rates read from genuine billing counters (Codex, DeepSeek, Anthropic, `dsh` projection cache & zstd session logs), never estimated; ACP uses an activity-based sliding timeout instead of a fixed 30-minute cutoff.
- **Explicit session lifecycle**: omitting `sessionId` starts a clean fresh session; passing the footer `sessionId` resumes context and cache across restarts.
- **Structured X-ray timeline**: collapsible per-job conversation view (`Thought for Ns`, expandable Stall Gatekeeper AI reasons, `Analyzed file #L10-50`, `Edited file +13 -4`, `Ran command · exit code` with terminal output, Markdown final response).
- **Two-level API channels**: add one API channel (Base URL + API key), click **Fetch Models** (`GET /models`) to batch-import models; keys live only in a private `secrets.json`.
- **Opt-in async background mode**: 1-second chat unlock plus a zero-token doorbell (`wait-job.mjs`) with recurring duration check-ins (`exit 5` + re-arm) that wakes the Lead Agent when a job finishes, stalls, fails, or hits a check-in interval.
- **Opt-in stall gatekeeper AI**: 2-choice `CONTINUE` (up to 3 deferrals) / `ALERT` judgment on silence timeouts with localized concise explanations expandable in the timeline.
- **Seamless restart handoff**: atomic job snapshots and checkpoints; on "continue" in a thread with unfinished work, one scoped `recover` lookup collects unread completed results (with durable `ack`) or resumes an interrupted job via `resumeJobId` with its original session, model, and worktree (zero lookups on ordinary chat).
- **Zero-mutation guarantee**: never touches `~/.codex/config.toml`, `~/.dsh/*`, `~/.claude/*`, or `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/*`.
- **Editable default role rules**: pre-filled Turn-1 guardrails for `Oracle` and `Hephaestus` (never re-injected on follow-up turns).
- **Two-layer sandbox**: `Oracle` is always read-only; `Hephaestus` defaults to `workspace-write` with a per-workspace write mutex.
- **Opt-in Git worktree parallelism**: independent writers run in isolated `astand/<jobId>` worktrees.
- **Smart model selection & live Codex quotas**: per-role ordered priority queues with optional `smart` selection mode, cooldown/auto-restore, inline custom numeric settings, and live Codex quota tracking.

## Engine support

- **OpenAI Codex CLI** — full native support (`codex app-server`): structured X-ray timeline, real Prompt Cache, live 5h/7d quota, mid-turn steer.
- **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh` / ACP)** — full native support for DeepSeek, Gemini 4 and OpenAI-compatible APIs/proxies: structured X-ray timeline, real Prompt Cache, two-level API channels with Fetch Models.
- **Anthropic Claude Code CLI** — standard support: `stream-json`, session resume, Prompt Cache telemetry.
- **Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`, Gemini 4)** — experimental / basic: headless CLI delegation with basic text output; no X-ray timeline or upstream cache counters yet.
